artifact.summary: Abstained. The specification gives only symbolic scaling relations (T_q = Theta(sqrt(T_cl)) and T_q = Theta(T_cl^(1/3))) and a generic walk-search template. It specifies no graph family, marked-vertex oracle, walk operator, coin or edge register, number of walk steps per query, or evolution time. Any circuit would be an invented construction, not a reconstruction of the source, so no code is emitted.

equation_mapping.explanation: A generic quadratic-speedup scaling relation, labeled standard background in the specification. It is a complexity statement, not a unitary operation, so it cannot be turned into a circuit.

The cubic-speedup scaling T_q = Theta(T_cl^(1/3)) is an asymptotic runtime claim inferred from the abstract. Realizing it needs an unspecified graph, oracle, and multi-step walk model, and asymptotic scaling cannot be implemented as a fixed circuit.

specification_changes.change: Narrowed the scope from a circuit implementation to no implementation (abstention).
specification_changes.reason: Both equations are asymptotic complexity relations with no operator-level definition. The missing graph family, oracle, walk operator, and per-query step count are essential details that cannot be resolved without fabrication.

unresolved_issues: Graph family and marked-vertex model are not specified
Oracle definition and cost model are not specified
Discrete-time walk operator (coin or edge register) and continuous-time Hamiltonian are not specified
Number of walk steps per oracle query and evolution times are not specified
No public validation contract or requested instance was supplied to narrow the construction
The initial state and readout are generic assumptions, not part of the source specification
